objective: Qualify frozen ungraded ZOE unchanged on complete fresh 5x4-k4 and independently require a nonzero exact-rank DEGREE1 contradiction count for the run to count as fresh non-affine evidence.
freshness: 5x4-k4 has not been used by the late-stage ZOE/parity derivation campaign
the carrier is selected before its scalar qualification is observed
it extends the known non-affine 4x4-k4 family in width rather than height, providing a directionally distinct test from 4x5-k4

frozenCandidate.name: ZOE
frozenCandidate.definition: For each exact canonical post-RFG component type T: omit T when n_T=0, emit O when n_T>0 is odd, and emit E when n_T>0 is even.

controls: DEGREE1 exact-rank affine GF(2)^2 component-parity model
antiCircularity: The carrier and candidate are frozen before any 5x4-k4 outcome qualification.
No carrier-specific count state, phase, coefficient, component identity selection, or topology refinement may alter ZOE.
Solved outcomes are used only after structural coordinate generation as class-purity checks and GF(2)^2 right-hand sides.
falsifiers: Any mixed scalar-value ZOE class rejects frozen ZOE on 5x4-k4.
MULTI failure rejects exact component-multiset Q-V sufficiency on the holdout.
If DEGREE1 has zero contradictions, the run remains transfer evidence but is not the requested fresh non-affine qualification.
resourceGuard: If exhaustive execution exceeds the runner resource envelope, record that as a resource observation and optimize execution without changing the frozen carrier or ZOE semantics.
successCriterion: ZOE has zero mixed scalar-value classes and DEGREE1 has at least one contradiction.
nextIfSuccess: Integrate ZOE and the parity-ceiling sequence into the foundational QU/IA audit, then test frontier-relative descriptor aggregation under ZOE counts.
nextIfAffine: Retain the transfer result and predeclare another carrier without changing ZOE.
nextIfZoeFails: Freeze the minimum ZOE collision and compare ZOE_R3/full multiplicity before any semantic refinement.
